## Experience

- [Blubridge Technologies (Nova MLIR)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00029): AI research intern (compiler team), Chennai, 07/2025 - 10/2025. Evaluated StableHLO tradeoffs to define a value-semantic MLIR dialect unifying forward and backward passes in Nova (BluTrain), researched progressive lowering (`nova -> linalg -> vector -> nvgpu -> NVVM -> PTX`) and cross-operator fusions, wrote 170+ pages of compiler notes, and mentored 4 incoming engineers on `torch.fx` capture and SSA lowering.

## Projects

- [Partha Tamil Tokenizer](https://github.com/barryallen16/partha-tamil-tokenizer): Rust BPE tokenizer with character seeding, promotion merges, 1,135 Tamil conjunct-stem base tokens, Rayon document batching, and bitset-guarded CSR merge tables. Uses 50.2% fewer tokens than OpenAI `o200k` and 54.2% fewer than mBERT on Tamil wiki (0.9193 bits/byte, +36.7-36.9% vs mBERT) with 100% ByteFallback decode fidelity across 56 Rust CI tests ([Playground](https://partha.isroot.in/), [Weights](https://huggingface.co/barryallen16/partha-tamil-tokenizer)).
- [FitCheck](https://github.com/barryallen16/fitcheck): Android AI wardrobe app (React Native, Expo SDK 52, local AsyncStorage) distilling `Qwen3-VL-8B` (538K caption-QA pairs across 106K IndoFashion images) and `gpt-oss-120b` (2.92K pairing rationales) into `Qwen3-VL-2B` via LoRA (3.14x lower VRAM, 7.23 to 2.30 GB, 91.6% teacher quality), paired with Q4_K_M GGUF local weights and 297 blind human ratings (r=0.303, p<0.05) ([Showcase](https://barryallen16.github.io/fitcheck-website), [Paper PDF](https://jayadithya.is-a.dev/fitcheck-journal-paper.pdf), [Models](https://huggingface.co/collections/barryallen16/fitcheck)).
- [D1-Triage](https://github.com/barryallen16/d1-triage): Local Semgrep Java alert triage CLI and API powered by Liquid AI `d1-3B` hybrid SSM with AST sink grounding (0.4297 to 0.5986 L0 within-rule AUC) and full-method logit-readout LoRA over 1,643 methods from 465 held-out commits (0.8339 GHSA L3 AUC, 0.6027 L3 within-rule AUC, 0.3023 P@90R across 174 GHSA and 14 Vul4J alerts). Runs in ~12 ms T4 forward pass (6.2 GB VRAM; 456.4 ms mean loop) or via `Q8_0` GGUF on CPU, backed by 52 pytest tests and 19 audit checks ([Demo](https://barryallen16.github.io/d1-triage/), [Weights](https://huggingface.co/barryallen16/d1-3B-java-vuln-triage), [Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/barryallen16/d1-triage)).
- [mono](https://github.com/barryallen16/mono): Offline Android voice notebook (`v1.2.0`, Expo SDK 52) linking Cactus 4.1.4 (`libcactus.a`) via C++ JNI + Kotlin `MediaCodec` Hann-windowed sinc resampling (16 kHz mono PCM), Svarah-tuned Whistle ASR (14.71% 100-clip WER vs 19.21% shipped 2-bit at 156.2 ms latency), and Needle 3 W4A8 `save_note` extraction (0.9444 task F1, 93.3% task exact match, 11.1% non-task false positives vs 72.2% base) into `expo-sqlite` ([Website](https://barryallen16.github.io/mono/), [Models](https://huggingface.co/collections/barryallen16/mono-6b0871a3c601170d2466fe8e), [Releases](https://github.com/barryallen16/mono/releases)).
- [Sivabharani Comments](https://github.com/barryallen16/sivabharani-comments): Multi-threaded 27-key Groq (`Qwen3.8-27B`) extraction pipeline processing 1.18M transcript chunks across 1,400 Tamil tech videos (36,818 65s windows) into hosted Meilisearch with 15,155 timestamp-pinned commenter hits ([Search](https://barryallen16.github.io/sivabharani-comments), [Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/barryallen16/sivabharani_comments)).
- [Kaggle Runner](https://github.com/barryallen16/kaggle-automation): Dockerized FastAPI control plane on AWS EC2 sharding GPU/TPU sweeps across 500+ production runs with 11h Telegram alerts, temp-disk ZIP streaming, and 154 pytest unit tests.
- [Txt](https://github.com/barryallen16/txt): Data-free Android SMS transfer protocol packing 1.2-2.8 KB photos, QR codes, GPS locations, and raw UPI links into GSM-7 base36/base64/CRC32 frames with native Kotlin `ContentObserver` (400ms debounce) and 93 bun tests ([PWA](https://txt.runs-on.dev/), [Releases](https://github.com/barryallen16/txt/releases)).
- [Resume Skill](https://github.com/barryallen16/resume-builder-skill): Deterministic 2-step resume compiler agent skill (`python-docx` + headless LibreOffice PDF) with TOON v4.4 serialization (25-65% token savings), fail-closed 1-page gate, and 73 unittest tests.
- [Clerk](https://github.com/barryallen16/clerk): Local-first FastAPI HR agent querying 27 ChromaDB chunks and booking leave in SQLite via typed JSON schemas on offline `lfm3-1.7b` (10/10 retrieval, 12/14 tool selection, 13/14 answer accuracy, 19 pytest CI tests).
